lines.NAR_Story_01: In the twenty-one hundreds, Earth began to die.
lines.NAR_Story_02: The land became barren, crops failed, and the oceans turned acidic.
lines.NAR_Story_03: People struggled to find food and clean water. Cities overflowed, and wars broke out over what little was left.
lines.NAR_Story_04: With resources running out, people escaped aboard ships and formed separate communities.
lines.NAR_Story_05: For years, they searched the oceans for a safe place to live.
lines.NAR_Story_06: Then, five communities discovered an island filled with fresh water, fertile land, and valuable resources.
lines.NAR_Story_07: They believed they had finally found a new home.
lines.NAR_Story_08: But the island has a Guardian, and it will accept only one community.
lines.NAR_Story_09: Each community has sent one champion. Three trials will decide who stands before the Guardian. Welcome, champions.
lines.NAR_Lobby_Welcome: Welcome to the gathering, champion. Share the room code with your friends. When five champions have joined, the trials can begin.
lines.NAR_Island_02: You are free to explore. Walk the beaches, climb the hills, and look for the old marker stones. They remember what happened here.
lines.NAR_Island_03: When the horn sounds, the first trial will begin.
lines.NAR_Lore_1: This island was once a paradise for the rich, built while the rest of the world went hungry.
lines.NAR_Lore_2: When the seas turned, the guests fled. Only the Guardian stayed behind.
lines.NAR_Lore_3: The Guardian was built to protect the island's water. It decides who may drink it.
lines.NAR_Lore_4: Others have come before you. Their names are carved into the stone, and then they disappear.
lines.NAR_Lore_5: Fresh water runs beneath your feet. Enough for one community. Never for five.
lines.NAR_S1_Welcome: Welcome to the first trial: the Number Game.
lines.NAR_S1_Rule1: Every round, each champion secretly picks a number from zero to one hundred.
lines.NAR_S1_Rule2: Then we take the average of all the numbers and multiply it by zero point eight. That is the target.
lines.NAR_S1_Rule3: The champion whose number is farthest from the target is eliminated.
lines.NAR_S1_Rule4: If champions tie for farthest, everyone picks again in sudden death, but only the tied can fall. And if you never lock in, the number on your dial counts. No number at all, and one is chosen for you.
lines.NAR_S1_Tip: Think about what the others will choose. Good luck.
lines.NAR_S2_Welcome: Welcome to the second trial: the Hidden Symbol. Four champions remain.
lines.NAR_S2_Rule1: Each of you carries a symbol: a heart, a diamond, a club, or a spade. Everyone can see your symbol, except you.
lines.NAR_S2_Rule2: First, you have thirty seconds to talk. Ask the others what you carry, but be careful, they might lie.
lines.NAR_S2_Rule3: Then you have ten seconds to name your own symbol. A correct answer earns one point.
lines.NAR_S2_Rule4: After three rounds, the two champions with the most points move on.
lines.NAR_S3_Welcome: Welcome to the final trial: the Race to the Guardian. Two champions remain.
lines.NAR_S3_Rule1: Each of you has a vehicle. Follow the green flares to the beam of light.
lines.NAR_S3_Rule2: Drive into the glowing ring around the beam. No stopping, no button. The first one in claims it.
lines.NAR_S3_Rule3: Reach it first and you choose first. But remember, winning the race does not win the island.
lines.NAR_Final_Welcome: Champions, you have reached the Guardian.
lines.NAR_Final_Rule1: The one who reached the Guardian first must now make a choice.
lines.NAR_Final_Rule2: Become the King, and you will rule the island, but your people will not follow you.
lines.NAR_Final_Rule3: Or save your people. You give your life, and your community is carried to safety. Then the choice passes to the other champion.
lines.NAR_Final_Rule4: If no choice is made in time, the Guardian will crown you King.
lines.NAR_Results: The trials are over. Thank you for playing, champions.
lines.NAR_Epi_01: Now that the trials are over, you deserve to know the truth about this island.
lines.NAR_Epi_02: Long before the oceans turned, one scientist saw it all coming. Doctor Elias Varne.
lines.NAR_Epi_03: He warned the world that the seas would burn and the land would fail. No one listened.
lines.NAR_Epi_04: So he built a backup for humanity. An island with clean water, living soil, and the seeds of every plant on Earth, hidden from the world.
lines.NAR_Epi_05: But he feared the strongest would come to take it, not the worthiest. So he left a keeper to choose for him. The Guardian.
lines.NAR_Epi_06: The Number Game tested the mind: who could think beyond the crowd.
lines.NAR_Epi_07: The Hidden Symbol tested trust and loyalty: who could rely on others, and be relied upon.
lines.NAR_Epi_08: The race tested resolve. And the final choice tested the heart: what you would give up for the people you love.
lines.NAR_Epi_Crown: Today, the island has a ruler. Whether the Guardian chose wisely, only time will tell.
lines.NAR_Epi_Gift: Today, one champion gave their life, and another led their people home. In that sacrifice, the Guardian found what Doctor Varne had hoped for.
lines.NAR_Epi_Saved: Today, no one claimed the island. They chose each other instead. And perhaps that was the answer Doctor Varne was waiting for.
